waypoints.label: Cedar Gap
waypoints.title: Start at the Cedar Gap pullout
waypoints.caption: The route starts at a gravel pullout at about 4,660 ft. The first mile climbs steadily.

waypoints.label: Mountain curve
waypoints.title: The climb eases and the trail wraps around the slope
waypoints.caption: After the first mile the grade eases, and the trail stays nearly level as it rounds the hillside.

waypoints.label: Saddle
waypoints.title: Cross the saddle
waypoints.caption: The low point between the level stretch and the final climb, 2.4 mi in. A natural place for a break.

waypoints.label: Rocky climb
waypoints.title: The rocky climb begins
waypoints.caption: From here to the top the trail is steep and rocky. Budget as long for this part as for everything before it.

waypoints.label: Steepest pitch
waypoints.title: Steepest pitch: loose rock underfoot
waypoints.caption: The steepest part of the route. Slow and careful, especially on the way down.

waypoints.label: Summit
waypoints.title: Reach the summit and turn around
waypoints.caption: The high point of the route. The way back is the way you came.
